en.t: The first autumn frost had fallen, and the morning light was clear and beautiful.

units.source_text: 那些替求爱者拉拢的侍女，拿来了偷偷送来的许多情书。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting who acted on behalf of the suitors brought many love letters that had been sent in secret.

units.source_text: 玉鬘自己并不看信，都由侍女读给她听。

en.t: Tamakazura did not read the letters herself; instead, the ladies-in-waiting read them aloud to her.

units.source_text: 髭黑大将的信中写道：“指望本月有成，不觉空过多日。

en.t: In General Higekuro's letter, he wrote, "I had hoped matters would be settled this month, yet many days have passed in vain without my realizing it.
I gaze wistfully at the cloudy sky, my heart burning with impatience."
